name: chromatin-accessibility-histone-analysis
description: Analyze chromatin accessibility (ATAC-seq) and histone modification (ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag) data. ATAC-seq uses Tn5 transposase to identify open chromatin regions. ChIP-seq and CUT&Tag profile histone marks (H3K4me3: active promoters, H3K27ac: active enhancers, H3K27me3: Polycomb repression, H3K36me3: active gene bodies). MACS2 calls peaks (enriched regions) against input/IgG control.
